field.name: parent
field.label: Reports to (job)
field.help: The default boss for new positions of this job that are added without a reporting position. Positions that already exist keep the one they have.

field.name: grade
field.label: Default grade
field.help: Sets the rank of this job's positions that have no grade of their own. Changing it is refused while it would put someone above their manager. Grades are set up in HR Configuration.
